name: What a line asks of me
says: the router reads whether a line asks a question, sets a task or gives a fact as the AMI Meeting Corpus's annotators marked its dialogue act, under ISO 24617-2's general-purpose functions; and whether a line is feedback on what was just said, as AMI's Backchannel acts are under the published mapping of AMI's classes to ISO 24617-2

measures.says: percent of the AMI scenario test partition's Elicit acts (test/oracle/corpus.json) the router reads as a question
percent of its Suggest and Offer acts the router reads as a task, once the meaning model has opened (the intent head, PROVIDERS.intent.head)
percent of its Inform acts the router reads as a fact (an untimed event counted as one)
percent of the AMI scenario test partition's Backchannel acts the autoFeedback head (PROVIDERS.intent.heads) reads as feedback, once the meaning model has opened
percent of its other mapped acts (Inform, Elicit, Suggest, Offer) that head does not read as feedback
